_doc: Phase D (D5): hand-labeled faithfulness regression set.
Each entry is a (ticket, call) pair where the QA team knows what
the synthesis pass should flag as a discrepancy. The runner
AI Reviewer and asserts that >= 90% of the listed discrepancies
show up in the synthesis output's `faithfulness.discrepancies[]`.
summary_substring: one short phrase that MUST appear in the AI's discrepancy.summary
severity_floor: 'info' | 'warn' | 'critical' (AI must emit at >= this severity)
Populate this file by hand from real cases your QA team has
already audited. Aim for 20 entries spanning all four kinds.
Keep `expected_discrepancies` short (1-3 per case) and use a
stable substring (not the full sentence) so prompt drift
